title: Karl Nell says disclosure is dead

tellings.quote: Um, but he just went on a podcast and he said disclosure is dead.

plain: Karl Nell, a former military officer who has argued for public release of what the government knows about UFOs, recently went on a podcast and said "disclosure is dead", meaning that such an official admission is not coming. Michels mentions this himself, relaying Nell's words from that other show, in a talk about how the Pentagon handles the subject.
